verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only a manual 'Suppress Person' API event and an 'Unsubscribed' segment. Neither documents automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, or spam complaints, nor that suppression is honored across broadcasts, transactional, and automation sends. Manual suppression and segmentation are adjacent controls, not the default-on hygiene this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
